body:
Codex resume brief: advisor, 2026-10-19 18:10. This REPLACES the handoff summary. Where it differs from codex-batch-speed.md, this brief wins.

Status: since #2757 (TASK-1944) at 08:29, nothing has landed from this lane. Item 1 (TASK-1944) is DONE: the advisor applied the triage directly, so leave #2757 alone; the advisor will close it. Everything below is still open. Work in this order, one PR each:

0. TASK-1949 = STORY-1853 S6, CI job fan-out. TOP PRIORITY. Start now.
   - Read `aida show TASK-1949 --full --comments` (including the 14:10 advisor comment) and the STORY-1853 08:30 ruling.
   - Branch from CURRENT origin/main. #2754 (S0/S0b/S1) merged at 128a5bb6eb and already changed ci.yml; build on top of it.
   - Split the single `build` job into parallel jobs that share the Swatinem/rust-cache key:
     (a) aida_cli_lib unit tests;
     (b) and (c) aida-cli integration binaries, split deterministically into two halves;
     (d) the remaining crates plus doctests;
     (e) every non-test gate.
   - Add an aggregate job named exactly `Build (ubuntu-latest)` with `needs:` on all of them. The required check name and merge-hold-gate stay unchanged.
   - Harden the store-attach guard (TASK-1949 comment): `git -C .aida-store rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree` is true for a plain directory inside the checkout, which made a trace-gate step reset the MAIN checkout on PR-2760. Check that `git -C .aida-store rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals "$PWD/.aida-store", or fail with the existing ::error::.
   - No test may be dropped. Put the passed+ignored count from your PR run and from a main run in the PR body.
   - Target: PR CI in 12 min or less. You can only validate this with the PR's own CI run, so push early and iterate.
   - Commit `[AI:codex] ci(build): fan out tests and gates into parallel jobs (TASK-1949)`.

1. #2712 (TASK-1801) final-round fix. Do it while item 0's CI runs; it's small.
   - Mail from 12:45; findings are in .aida/review-verdicts/PR-2712.json in the primary checkout.
   - MAJOR: review_verdict.rs ~1626-1644 `archived_recordings` reads the per-commit archive with raw std::fs::read_dir / read_to_string, bypassing read_verdict_body. It came in from main (#2755, BUG-2186) and feeds rework_hold_release.rs:242. Route it through the anchored reader, refuse non-regular or hardlinked entries, and add a test with a symlinked or hardlinked archive entry that gets refused.
   - Keep the OVERVIEW.md/AGENTS.md "every production verdict reader is anchored" claim true.
   - Document the link_then_unlink nlink=2 window (review_verdict.rs ~551-569).
   - Merge origin/main first.

2. BUG-2190: `aida list` open lens / `--status` show 0. Root cause: a persisted focus. Plain `aida list` hides everything while a focus is set; `--no-focus` shows 100. Fix it so the output says a focus is hiding N specs and how to clear it, or so a stale focus can't hide the open list. Add a regression test.

3. BUG-2187: a headless attested reviewer can't record a verdict with AIDA_AGENT_TYPE/NAME unset (see codex-batch-speed.md item 3).

4. BUG-2188 + BUG-2168: `aida agent new` reliability, one PR (codex-batch-speed.md item 4).

5. TASK-1945: review-on-push pipeline (codex-batch-speed.md item 5).

Unchanged rules:
- Local gate: make check-ci-fast + targeted filters + make check-ci-compile.
- Never run the full suite locally, never set AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT, never put an outer `timeout` on cargo (use AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT).
- New commands register in their own module.
- Be 0 behind main before you push.
- Open the PR (not a draft), then `aida mailbox send --to advisor --subject "PR-N ready (<ID>)" "<SHA + one line per AC>"`. Never merge your own PR.
- If you're blocked, mail the advisor the exact error and move to the next item. Don't stop, and don't wait for a reply.
subject: RESUME BRIEF (supersedes handoff summary): item 0 = TASK-1949 S6 first
